newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle trade light at $70 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle trade light at $70 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle trade was slow at $70.00 per cwt, mostly steady with Wednesday's light activity, feedlot sources said.
About 6,000 head traded in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area, sources there said. In Kansas, 500 head had been sold on a carcass basis at $113.00 per cwt, USDA said.
A limited number of cattle sold at $71.00 Wednesday in Nebraska and Texas, and at $114.00 on a dressed basis in Nebraska.
Packers and cattle owners generally remained at a standoff, with the bulk of owners asking $71.00 to $72.00.
